When Hope begins experiencing mental illness and troubling visions, Talia learns her husband was part of a sinister cult, and Hope is marked as "The Chosen Soul". Talia must race against time to save her daughter before it's too late.

programme.title: Thicker the Berry the Sweeter the Juice 2
programme.desc: Rising Celebrity News Reporter, Cherish has old flames and new loves collide when her past with her ex-Khalil returns, alongside the return of Caine, who threatens everything she's built. Will she choose true love or stay the course for her career?

programme.title: Maniac Cop 3: Badge of Silence
programme.desc: Cop Katie Sullivan (Gretchen Becker) shoots two crooks who are robbing a store, and though she's also wounded in the process, reporters cast her as a trigger-happy rogue. Devious police department bosses, hoping to get rid of a public relations problem, plan to kill Sullivan. But Matt Cordell (Robert Z'Dar), a dead cop who's just been resurrected, takes a liking to Sullivan and is determined to mow down her enemies before a police detective, Sean McKinney (Robert Davi), can stop him.

programme.title: Eraserhead [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Henry (John Nance) resides alone in a bleak apartment surrounded by industrial gloom. When he discovers that an earlier fling with Mary X (Charlotte Stewart) left her pregnant, he marries the expectant mother and has her move in with him. Things take a decidedly strange turn when the couple's baby turns out to be a bizarre lizard-like creature that won't stop wailing. Other characters, including a disfigured lady who lives inside a radiator, inhabit the building and add to Henry's troubles.

programme.title: Chopping Mall [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Eight teenagers are trapped after hours in a high-tech shopping mall and pursued by three murderous security robots out of control.

programme.title: Swarmed
programme.desc: The residents of a small town find themselves battling a swarm of hornets that have been sprayed by a super pesticide.

programme.title: Elvira's Movie Macabre: Manos: The Hands Of Fate
programme.desc: A revamping, if you will, of the 1980's classic horror movie showcase, hosted by Elvira, Mistress of the Dark. Elvira tries to elevate the material by hosting Manos as if it were an episode of Masterpiece Theater.

programme.title: Long Weekend
programme.desc: Peter (John Hargreaves) and Marcia (Briony Behets), a bitter married couple teetering on the edge of divorce, take a camping trip to heal the rift between them. As the weekend progresses, the selfish pair engage in reckless behavior that demonstrates an increasing disrespect for their natural surroundings. When Peter and Marcia become the targets of a series of inexplicable animal attacks, it becomes clear that an angry Mother Nature has come to exact her revenge.

programme.title: Fade To Black [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: A shy, lonely film buff embarks on a killing spree against those who browbeat and betray him, all the while stalking his idol, a Marilyn Monroe lookalike.

programme.title: Living Dark: The Story of Ted the Caver
programme.desc: Two estranged brothers become obsessed with gaining access to an unexplored cave, despite the horrors they encounter during their excavation.

programme.title: Spiders 2
programme.desc: Alexandra (Stephanie Niznik) and Jason (Greg Cromer) are a married couple whose yacht fails to withstand a storm at sea. They're saved from the stormy waters by Capt. Bigelow (Daniel Quinn) and his crew, who man a cargo ship. Jason is heavily drugged by the ship's doctor, Gerbac (Richard Moll), and realizes something is amiss when he comes across corpses. Meanwhile, Gerbac is working on a dangerous scientific experiment using spider eggs, which he hopes to implant in Jason's body.

programme.title: Hush (2016) [B&W Shush Cut] [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: A deaf and mute writer who retreated into the woods to live a solitary life must fight for her life in silence when a masked killer appears at her window.

programme.title: A Fantastic Fear Of Everything [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: A crime novelist whose research on Victorian serial killers has turned him into a paranoid wreck must confront his worst fears when a film executive takes a sudden interest in his movie script.

programme.title: Megaboa
programme.desc: On a trip to Colombia, a group of college students heads into the rainforest to look for cave drawings. Instead, they find a 50-foot boa constrictor.

programme.title: The Exorcist III: Legion (Director's Cut) [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Police Lt. Kinderman (George C. Scott) notices similarities between his current murder investigation and the methods used by the Gemini killer (Brad Dourif) who was executed 15 years before. He soon discovers a hospitalized mental patient (Jason Miller) claiming to be the dead serial killer, but who looks uncannily like a priest Kinderman knew who died during an exorcism. As more bodies are found, Kinderman looks for connections between the two supposedly dead men.

programme.title: Soviet Storm
programme.desc: By summer 1944, Germany has undeniably lost the battle of the USSR. After the Soviet victories at Moscow, Stalingrad, Kursk, and Leningrad, the Soviet Union, with its practically unlimited resources of manpower and matériel, begins to rapidly push the Germans back toward the German border. On 22 June 1944, Stalin launches Operation Bagration, named after a Russian hero of the Napoleonic Wars.

programme.title: Architects of Darkness
programme.desc: The drug addicted dilettante who created the Luftwaffe. Goering was at Hitler's side from the ill-fated Beer Hall putsch of 1923 until the estrangement between the two in April 1945 when Hitler ordered Goering's arrest.

programme.title: WWII: The Road To Victory
programme.desc: The leaders of the Pacific are discussed: Chester M. Nimitz, Douglas MacArthur.

programme.title: Battle for Cassino
programme.desc: The Battle For Monte Cassino marked one of the longest and bloodiest engagements of the Italian campaign during World War II. For 9 months, the Allies struggled to take the Gustav Line and the abbey of Monte Cassino. In May 1944, the Gustav Line finally collapsed, with the Second Polish Corps succeeding in capturing the abbey. The Allies had paid a big price, but now the road to Rome was open.

programme.title: Mission Invisible
programme.desc: The largest nuclear submarine ever built is Russian. Carrying 20 ballistic missiles inside its 179 meter long hull, the Typhoon-class ship has been designed as the weapon of last resort. Until now however, only glimpses of the largest and deadliest killing machine on Earth have been available.

programme.title: The Amazing World of War Machines
programme.desc: Rockets and guided missiles are the essential component of any military arsenal. By definition, rockets are unguided and follow the laws of physics and trajectory; whereas missiles are guided, either remotely or internally. There are many different types of missiles, including anti-tank and anti-aircraft missiles, surface to air missiles, and ballistic missiles.

programme.title: WWII: The Call of Duty
programme.desc: When Winston Churchill becomes Prime Minister of the wartime coalition government in May 1940, he pledges his blood, toil, tears and sweat; within days of his appointment, he is made to honor his promise; with France near defeat and Allied soldiers trapped at Dunkirk, Churchill faces a critical challenge; capturing the drama and resilience that defined his leadership during Britain's darkest hour.

programme.title: WWII: The Call of Duty
programme.desc: With mainland Europe under Hitler's control, the German Fuhrer turned his attention to Operation Sealion, and the Battle of Britain. However he'd underestimated the enormity of the task and the spirit of a nation inspired by Winston Churchill.

programme.title: D-Day: 100 Days for Freedom
programme.desc: From the hedgerows of Normandy to the liberation of Paris, this episode retraces the 100 critical days after D-Day. Witness the fierce battles, the resilience of soldiers, and the toll on civilians as the Allies push through German defenses, paving the way for Europe's liberation and altering the course of World War II.

programme.title: U.S. Marines in Vietnam
programme.desc: The 'First Battle of Saigon' was fought during the Tet Offensive launched in January 1968. The Vietcong launched 35 battalions at Saigon. The objective was not to take the entire city, which while a major force was not strong enough to take and control the entire city, but concentrated on six main targets in the city.

programme.title: WWII In Color: D-Day to Nazi Downfall
programme.desc: With fuel and supplies all but depleted, the Germans withdraw and end up back where they started. With the battle won, hard questions are asked as to how such a bitter and bloody battle could catch the Allies off-guard, and surviving servicemen from across the lines share thoughts and memories that embody the fighting spirit of the American armed forces.

programme.title: Arnhem 1944: A Bridge Too Far Collection
programme.desc: The Battle for control of Arnhem with exclusive interviews with veteran of the Battle Tom Hicks.

programme.title: Hidden Side of World War II
programme.desc: This section takes a look behind the scenes at D-Day, revealing confidential decisions taken by the rulers, as well as the involvement of top-ranking officers and secret agents in the operations.

programme.title: The Flying Tigers
programme.desc: In 1941, a motley dressed group of Americans sailed across the Pacific. Few who saw this ragtag group would've guessed that they would soon become one of the most famous military units in history. The American Volunteer Group entered the war through the backdoor, literally. By the time they arrived in Asia, Japan controlled all of China's ports. So they traveled to Rangoon, Burma.
programme.sub-title: Battle Over China - The Tigers Swipe

programme.title: WWII In Color: D-Day to Nazi Downfall
programme.desc: The Soviet forces on Germany's eastern border, now refreshed and resupplied, are given a challenge by premiere Stalin.

programme.title: Blitzkrieg: The Lightning War
programme.desc: By the late Summer of 1940 Nazi Germany controlled virtually all of Europe. Beginning in 1936 Germany employed a combination of political intimidation and a series of swift military attacks known as Blitzkrieg to overrun one country after another. Austria, Czechoslovakia, Poland, Norway, Denmark, Holland, Belgium and France all collapse before the onslaught of Hitler's seemingly invincible might.

programme.title: The Vietnam War: Defeat and Departure
programme.desc: The final part of the story of the Vietnam War from the perspective of both sides, including some incredible rare war time footage from North Vietnamese sources.

programme.title: Secrets of the Nazis
programme.desc: Through the stories of a jurist, an executioner, and a regime opponent, this investigation reveals how Nazi law justified extermination. Expert voices and archives show how Germany's intellectual elite enabled a murderous totalitarian state.
programme.sub-title: A Justice of Terror - Part II: Twisted Justice on Trial

programme.title: The Concise History of WWII
programme.desc: 'The Concise History of World War II' begins by looking at Germany during the years between World War one and World War two, and pays particular attention to a young and charismatic politician by the name of Adolf Hitler, who dramatically rose to prominence as leader of the Nazi Party during a time of severe economic instability and mass unemployment.

programme.title: WWII: The Road To Victory
programme.desc: This episode covers late 1943 and 1944 and shows the preparation for further action after Italy soon joined the allied side due to the defeat of Mussolini. The invasion of France is also discussed.

programme.title: Annihilation: The Destruction of European Jews
programme.desc: Leading historians reflect on the barbarity of the Holocaust. By 1941, the Nazis were using gas as the hideous method for mass killings at their death camps - including Auschwitz.

programme.title: Nancy Wake: Gestapo's Most Wanted
programme.desc: This is the incredible true story of Nancy Wake. Codenamed 'The White Mouse' for her elusiveness, she was a key inspiration behind Sebastian Faulkes' celebrated fictional spy Charlotte Gray. In this first ever docudrama biopic on Wake, gripping dramatisations are combined with exclusive interviews with her closest friends, confidants and military historians to bring her legend to life.

programme.title: Eva Braun: In Love With Adolf Hitler
programme.desc: It was a strange affair, full of love, lust and despair... That of Adolf Hitler and Eva Braun, his mistress from 1932 to their double suicide in Hitler's Berlin bunker, that fateful day in April 1945.

programme.title: WWII: The Road To Victory
programme.desc: The landings on the beaches of Normandy, the first step in the operation, codenamed Overlord enterprise by Dwight D. Eisenhower. The greatest amphibious invasion in history.

programme.title: WWII: The Price of Empire
programme.desc: The second world war ended more than 70 years ago, but wars never end. For those who fought the memories are indestructible. To understand something so profound we must start before the beginning with what Churchill called, The Gathering Storm.

programme.title: Military Aircraft of the 20th Century: Helicopters
programme.desc: Providing exact numbers, specifications, and plenty of facts, Military Aircraft of the 20th Century provides an encyclopedic look at aircrafts used by any military force in the 20th century. This entry looks at helicopters, such as the Bell UH-1 Iroquois 'Huey', Bristol 173, Sikorsky SH-3 Sea King, Sikorsky H-34 Choctaw, and many more.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Today is all about stock and soup! Join Lidia as she prepares three heart-warming soups. Chicken stock made into "Stracciatella", laced with eggs and spinach, Stuffed Veal Chop with oozing Fontina, and a Braised Kale with Bacon.

programme.title: Billy & Dom Eat The World
programme.desc: Billy and Dom learn the secrets behind the perfect traditional English roast dinner in London's historic Borough Market, explore the best of the diverse food offerings in Brick Lane and pop in to see their friend, Sir Ian McKellen, in his pub in East London.
programme.sub-title: Billy & Dom Eat The World - London

programme.title: Billy & Dom Eat The World
programme.desc: Billy and Dom traverse the Isles of Lewis and Harris, where they attend an agricultural show and are invited to a traditional Scottish cèilidh. They meet the Hebridean Baker who treats them to an alfresco dinner on the Isle of Taransay, and visit the Isle of Harris Distillery to try their offering of gin and whisky.
programme.sub-title: Billy & Dom Eat The World - Scotland

programme.title: Billy & Dom Eat The World
programme.desc: Billy and Dom head to Dom's hometown of Manchester, the world's first industrialised city and now a vibrant food capital. They brunch at cult diner Gooey, learn to cook curry at a classic "Rice & Three" café, explore the science behind ice cream cones, and enjoy a special tour of Manchester United's iconic stadium.

While Darkman is perfecting an artificial skin that will restore his old appearance, Durant inexplicably returns to torment him. Overcome by rage, Darkman disguises himself with the artificial skin, setting out to infiltrate Durant's world and bring him to justice.

programme.title: Frenzy

When short-tempered ex-Royal Air Force officer Richard Blaney (Jon Finch) discovers his ex-wife (Barbara Leigh-Hunt) murdered, Blaney becomes a suspect. Forced to go on the run, Blaney attempts to take refuge with his best friend, fruit merchant Bob Rusk (Barry Foster) ; however, Rusk may, in fact, be the necktie murderer himself.

programme.title: Bustin' Loose
programme.desc: Parole officer Donald (Robert Christian) compels his foul-mouthed ex-con charge Joe Braxton (Richard Pryor) to escort a bus full of special education students from Philadelphia to the Pacific Northwest, where their teacher Vivian Perry (Cicely Tyson) plans to set up a new school. But when Braxton's latest attempt at going straight becomes a frustrating series of mishaps, he struggles to complete the job he was hired to do while resisting his growing affection for Vivian and the children.

programme.desc: Smarting from a romantic breakup, macho police Sgt. Joe Bomowski (Sylvester Stallone) gets a cross-country visit from his mother, Tutti (Estelle Getty). Her misguided efforts to help only fray his nerves, but that doesn't stop her from nagging Joe to be more open about his feelings toward his ex-girlfriend and current boss, Lt. Gwen Harper (JoBeth Williams). When Tutti witnesses a brutal multiple murder, she takes her meddling to the extreme by tagging along to help her son solve the case.

programme.title: Streets of Fire
programme.desc: Raven Shaddock (Willem Dafoe), along with his gang of merciless biker friends, kidnaps rock singer Ellen Aim (Diane Lane). Ellen's former lover, soldier-for-hire Tom Cody (Michael Paré), happens to be passing through town on a visit. In an attempt to save his star act, Ellen's manager, Billy Fish (Rick Moranis), hires Tom to rescue Ellen. Billy and Tom, along with former soldier McCoy (Amy Madigan), battle through dangerous cityscapes, determined to get Ellen back.

programme.title: Sneakers
programme.desc: Computer hacker Martin (Robert Redford) heads a group of specialists who test the security of various San Francisco companies. Martin is approached by two National Security Agency officers who ask him to steal a newly invented decoder. Martin and his team discover that the black box can crack any encryption code, posing a huge threat if it lands in the wrong hands. When Martin realizes the NSA men who approached him are rogue agents, they frame him for the murder of the device's inventor.

programme.title: The Car
programme.desc: Two bicyclists are run down by a strange black car in the desert near a small town in Utah. But this is just the first in a series of hit-and-run murders. Sheriff Wade Parent is called in to investigate, and his deputy, Everett, is killed by the black sedan, which, some witnesses say, has no one behind its wheel. When the car threatens a local school parade, the lives of the town's children and Wade's teacher girlfriend, Lauren, are endangered.

programme.title: Black Dog
programme.desc: An ex-con takes a job truck driving across the country. However, the truck is filled with illegal weapons, and now he must fight to save his family. The stakes are high as gun runners, government agents and a fleet of monstrous 18-wheelers pursue him in an intense highway duel.

Murad wants revenge and hires anonymous hit man the Jackal (Bruce Willis) to kill FBI Deputy Director Carter Preston (Sidney Poitier). With the help of Russian agent Valentina Koslova (Diane Venora), Preston finds the only man who knows what the notorious Jackal looks like, imprisoned IRA terrorist Declan Mulqueen (Richard Gere), and forces him to help hunt down the hit man.

When Master Wong refuses for pacifist reasons, the sisters try to trick his students, Club Foot Seven and Butcher Wing into helping them.

programme.title: Lady Constables
programme.desc: Two female and one male (the strong, silent type) constables compete to recapture the Night-Shining Pearl, stolen by the Four Chiefs, who are led by the treacherous White Haired General Coldwater Tiger.

programme.title: Big Family
programme.desc: Shek Kin plays the head of a large crime family. His sons get into all sorts of trouble with the other triad bosses. They escalate the situation with drugs, Kung Fu Tournaments and murder, creating a bitter feud with a rival family.

programme.title: Martial Hero
programme.desc: The story is about a humble man known as the Canton Kid, who just happens to have extraordinary kung fu talent. When the Town Triads team up with a warlord they bring the town to its knees, the Canton kid steps in to restore the peace.

programme.title: 52 Masters
programme.desc: Will trains in the physically punishing Kyokushin-Kan style of full-contact Karate with Shihan Tom Callahan.
programme.sub-title: 52 Masters: KYOKUSHIN-KAN KARATE with Tom Callahan

programme.title: Dynamite Shaolin Heroes: See Shaolin Dynamite Heroes-Sho Kosghi Ninja Theatre 5
programme.desc: From the ashes of the Ming Dynasty come the dynamite Shaolin heroes, wading through patriots and warring government agents to try and keep the country from falling apart. But there is a mysterious lotus kung fu master at large, and can their mysterious skills overcome this deadly challenge? Without warning, they will seek out and destroy the world's most dangerous villains with their explosive kicks and punches!

programme.title: American Force 2: The Untouchable Glory
programme.desc: When America and Russia make a move in a power nuclear power-play in SouthEast Asia, a team of elite American commandos are ready for action. Their mission: to liquidate the Soviet espionage team headed by General Karpov, and give assistance and advice to the 'Untouchables', the local civilian counter-insurgency group led by ex-cop Domingo.

programme.title: Evil Destroyer
programme.desc: Father Luke Daniels tries to stop the flow of opium into his country but finds himself facing off against the evil Mr. Wu and 'Blackstone, a man who isn't afraid to use clown ninjas and hopping vampires to get his way.

programme.title: Butterfly Killer
programme.desc: When a man is cruelly murdered by a gang of opium dealers, his young granddaughter must use her knowledge of kung fu to avenge him.

programme.title: The Revenger
programme.desc: TI LUNG stars as the Kung Fu warrior Shao Tu, dedicated to help the oppressed, but who makes many deadly enemies along the way. One of which is Mao (Wong Ching) who with his army of fighters hatches a deadly plot to bring about the downfall of Shao Tu.

programme.title: Mission for the Dragon
programme.desc: After a valuable antique is stolen; two sons (Dragon Lee and Carter Wong) swear to avenge their father's death and search of the last man to see him alive, but they are caught in a mystery of betrayal and murder. The brothers use their heads as well as their fists to find out why their father had to die.

programme.title: Blade Of Doom
programme.desc: A roving swordsman known as Snowy White has in his possession the much sort after 13 Moon Sword. Anyone who manages to defeat him in combat may own the sword and take a high position in the martial world.

programme.title: 7 Star Grand Mantis
programme.desc: A village is being oppressed by four villains led by Chow Chung. A beggar comes to town and teaches a young man and woman the 7 Star Grand Mantis style of fighting. They stomp out the gangs businesses and fight them to the finish.

programme.title: Snake Strikes Back
programme.desc: Godfrey Ho directs Elton Chong in a Jackie Chan style action comedy. Sui, plots to take over the Absolute Kung Fu Institute in order to control the secret Book of the Invincible Snake Fist. The only man who can stop him is Lam, the institutes most devoted student. He must train hard with the pot-bellied Beggar Master if he is to acheive his ambition.

programme.title: Bruce - Kung Fu Girls
programme.desc: Five pretty girls go to Hong Kong to stay with their uncle who is a police superintendent. Soon they run into a gang of thieves, which gives them a chance to put their excellent kung fu skills to good use. This Bod Squad will kick your ass!

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Chema les ofrece refugio al Turco y la familia de Aurelio en una de sus casas de Los Ángeles para tenderles una trampa. Mónica tiene que matar al cocinero para poder escapar.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Mónica vuelve a casa y se encuentra con noticias impactantes. Tras una llamada de su hija Rutila, Aurelio recorre Los Ángeles en busca del Turco y su familia.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Aurelio invita al Cabo a San Luis Potosí para eliminar a Colmenares, pero la relación es muy tensa entre ellos. Heriberto negocia con los secuestradores, y Matilde admira su valentía.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: El Turco llega a tiempo para salvar al Cabo de la ira de los Casillas, y les entrega los resultados de ADN de Tijeras como prueba de fidelidad. Chacorta sorprende a Matilde en Colombia.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Aurelio llega al hotel para evitar que Ximena escape, donde se enfrenta al Turco por su engaño. Mejía le pide a Benítez que no le diga al presidente sobre sus sospechas del asesinato de Colmenares.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: El presidente Benítez le dice a Marco Mejía que lo respalda y que jamás negociará con criminales. Aurelio espera una respuesta. Chacorta lleva a Matilde al hospital, y Heriberto se pone muy mal.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Aurelio invita a comer a Ximena, pero el Cabo y sus hombres llegan hasta el restaurante donde él está y se presenta una balacera. Chacorta se venga de Heriberto al saber de su relación con Matilde.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Casillas intenta llevarse a Ximena al extranjero, pero ella logra desarmar a uno de los hombres de Aurelio y lo amenaza. Doña Alba no acepta irse con él, y le canta las verdades en su cara.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Aurelio regresa a México y se lleva una sorpresa cuando llega a la bodega, por lo que decide cambiarse el rostro. El Cabo le dice al Chema que él se encarga de encontrar a Casillas con ayuda de Irina.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Aurelio Casillas se somete a cirugía estética, pero el procedimiento se complica y Heriberto pierde el control. Rutila le miente a Ximena por temor al Turco: le dice que extraña a su padre.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Todos creen que Aurelio Casillas ha muerto en una sala de operaciones. Sin embargo, la muerte que tanto impactó al mundo del narco mexicano es, en realidad, una mentira de quien busca venganza.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Aurelio captura al Turco y lo tortura para descubrir dónde está el dinero que le robó. Mientras, el Chema Venegas, desconfiando de los Casillas, ordena a Tijeras secuestrar a doña Alba.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Después de un tiroteo, Chacorta y sus hombres rescatan a doña Alba. El Chema se obsesiona con conocer la verdad sobre la muerte de Aurelio, y pide la lista de doctores que lo operaron.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Ximena confiesa que no ama al Turco, que solo sintió agradecimiento por él. Después de matar a Ronnie, Aurelio encuentra a su exesposa, quien le dice que nunca volverá con él.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Luego de separarse tras el tiroteo, Aurelio y Ximena se reúnen con sus hijos. El Turco usa a Irina para averiguar el paradero de Casillas, y así poder negociar con él.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Matilde quiere aliarse con Chema para hacer un negocio a espaldas de Chacorta. Lay se mete a la tina con Aurelio y, luego de algunas confesiones, pasan una noche de pasión.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Aurelio visita a Mónica para amenazarla, pero ella recuerda el daño que él le hizo y se defiende. Más tarde, los hombres de Leonor se enfrentan a Chacorta y a Heriberto en una emboscada.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Aurelio le dice a Mónica que fingió su muerte para cobrar venganza de sus enemigos. Ximena se reencuentra con su hijo Heriberto, quien necesita de su ayuda para salir del mundo del narcotráfico.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Aurelio le tiende una trampa al Turco y lo amenaza, pero no recibe respuestas sobre el dinero. Después de mucho buscar a Leo, Ignacio Miravalle la encuentra y jura ayudarla a salir de la cárcel.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Mónica sugiere que Aurelio negocie su propia mercancía y la divida con los colombianos. Doña Alba se interpone cuando la idea separa a los hermanos Casillas.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Se planean dos ataques durante la reunión entre el presidente mexicano y el director de la DEA de EE. UU. Luego de una injusta pelea, acusan a Leonor de matar a una prisionera.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Mónica descubre que Aurelio viajará con Lay, y en un ataque de celos, amenaza con matarla. El Cabo busca la ayuda de Robles para viajar a Colombia, y le propone trabajar juntos.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Heriberto visita a Ignacio y le pide ayuda para salir del país. Mónica le dispara a Irina para evitar que huya de México. Chema quiere obtener ADN de Aurelio para compararlo con el del cadáver.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Heriberto le confiesa a Ximena que se va a Europa para salirse del mundo de la droga. Elsa elige lanzarse como candidata, en lugar de aceptar un puesto en el gabinete presidencial.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Leonor es llevada a juicio, y aunque Ignacio maneja su defensa, la condenan a 15 años. Mientras, Pedro busca el apoyo de Max y Elsa el de Chema durante la campaña para la gubernatura de Jalisco.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Aurelio toma al Cabo como rehén y viaja a Colombia, donde toma venganza matando a su hijo. Luego se interna con Mónica en la selva colombiana, él con el nombre de Francisco, ella como Dolores.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Tayra se traga casi 10 mil dólares para protegerlos de unos traficantes, luego los evacua y paga sus gastos médicos. César pone al niño a lamer piernas de mujeres porque su saliva es curativa.
programme.sub-title: Dinero tragado, dinero cagado; Chupa piernas

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: La bebé de Isaak y Paula murió mientras dormía, ella lo culpa porque cuando era niño lo acusaron de asesinato. Demandan a pareja gay que llamó a la policía para denunciar supuesto acto sexual.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Judith fue deportada y deja a su hija, busca recuperarla porque su madre adoptiva tiene un cibercafé porno. Dos strippers pelean mientras le bailaban a un cliente y una resulta lesionada.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Una acróbata muere durante una fiesta, su hermana demanda a la abuela del niño que causó la tragedia. Verónica ayuda a Alfonso con su sobrepeso, él no sabe que sus fotos están en Internet.
programme.sub-title: El último show; Haz de mí lo que quieras

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Liliana creía que su esposo recaudaba dinero para tratar el cáncer de su mascota. Catalina quien fue víctima de trata de blancas y obligada a prostituirse en México, demanda a su verdugo.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Viviana y Mariano son una pareja de adultos mayores, pero él tiene una amante joven. Laura está inhabilitada y recibe compensación económica, su esposo quiere el divorcio y muchos beneficios.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Vanessa quiere la custodia de su hijo porque Raúl le enseñó magia y se ganan la vida con trucos en la calle. Marta recauda dinero para ayudar a Brenda a combatir el cáncer, pero ella está sana.
programme.sub-title: Sin truco no hay magia; Disgusto vaginal

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Ana le exige indemnización al pastor que abusaba sexualmente de su madre y lo responsabiliza por su suicidio. Víctor aloja en su casa al exmarido de su esposa, ella demanda que lo saque.
programme.sub-title: Adicto a mi madre; Fanático sin sentido

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Karla usa una aplicación de teléfono para sus compras y se hizo amiga del mensajero, su esposo la acusa de tener sexo oral con él. Un psicólogo trata a sus pacientes con un método peculiar.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Vanesa se casa con Eduardo y comete el error de poner todo su dinero a nombre de él. También, Alejandro quiere recibir terapia de pareja con su esposa Carla para así salvar su matrimonio.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Laura destruyó el dron de Gino que volaba sobre su propiedad, él pide que se lo pague. Mileidy crea una aplicación para identificar enfermedades sexuales y descubre que su esposo es infiel.
programme.sub-title: Propiedad violada; App para enfermedades sexuales

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: María y Paula causaron un alboroto ante las intimidaciones de Andrés y Sebastián, ellos las demandan. Elvis miente sobre su edad en papeles oficiales y le niegan la ayuda a su hijo autista.
programme.sub-title: Billetes en la carretera; Cambio de edad

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Lorena quiere la custodia de su hijo porque su esposo, quien destila alcohol ilegalmente, ofreció un coctel durante una fiesta infantil. Alexis se cambia de género y tiene sexo con su padre.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Antonio no quiere que su hija sea futbolista, porque no tendrá buen futuro, su madre pide la tutela de la joven. Los dueños de una casa confundieron a su empleado con un ladrón y lo lesionaron.
programme.sub-title: Sueño trunchado; Humillado y sin dinero

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Omaira pide que su suegra desaloje la casa porque interfiere constantemente en su matrimonio y su esposo actúa como un bebé de mamá. Lina hace videos eróticos con globos de diferentes tamaños.
programme.sub-title: El bebé de mami; La looner

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Paula fue condenada por robar el auto de David y secuestrar al bebé que estaba dentro. Sin embargo, ella alega que el bebé estaba a punto de morir de frío, porque él lo tenía descuidado en el auto mientras se drogaba. La "ley del hielo" no es más que ignorar a la persona con la que se convive y aplicar un silencio sepulcral, que en algún punto puede ser maltrato psicológico. Eso es lo que está haciendo Marcos con su esposa Yésica.
programme.sub-title: Minutos de vida; Ley del hielo

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Jonatan no quiere que su esposa trabaje más en un Pole Dance donde es popular porque de sus senos brota leche. Mildren demanda al entrenador de gimnasia de su hija por exigirle demasiado.
programme.sub-title: La vaca lechera; La niña gimnasta

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Daniela le exige a Milena una compensación por despido injustificado y por revelar un secreto. Harry pide un masaje prostático, pero al descubrir que el masajista era hombre destruye el local.
programme.sub-title: Auto grande, pito chico; Pánico gay

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Walker quiere desalojar a su sobrina e hijastra de la casa porque la chica solo ha vivido como una mantenida sin prestarle atención a sus estudios ni a la gestión de la empresa familiar. Carmen preparó la celebración de la renovación de los votos matrimoniales de sus padres, pero el padre, en plena ceremonia, revela que todo ha sido una farsa y que no está dispuesto a seguir viviendo con alguien por la que no siente nada.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Acepta hacer un documental sobre su vida como indocumentado y ahora está en el limbo. También, Edison y Caroline exigen que su hijo abandone la casa y no se acerque más a ellos.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Vicky demanda por acoso sexual a Lorenzo, pero solo puede probarlo por el lunar en su pene. El esposo de Eliana le deja herencia a ella y a sus hijas, pero aparece Laura y reclama su parte.
programme.sub-title: Acosador en libertad; ADN vs. cenizas

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Mariana le exige a su madre, Teresa, una compensación económica por los años de abandono que vivió. Maribel se sintió intimidada por Carlos y le propinó una golpiza, él pide una indemnización.
programme.sub-title: La hija del difunto; Peligro en la carretera

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Al estar bajo hipnosis Rafael se sintió acosado sexualmente, pide una compensación. El rapero Omni le reclama a Yerald la autoría de una canción, pero no se sabe la letra, porque se la robó.
programme.sub-title: Violado por alma gemela; El rapero sin rap

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Roxana exige que Jonathan, el hijo de su pareja, abandone la casa de la cual ella es copropietaria. Además, Julio es un exitoso boxeador, pero es homosexual y nadie lo sabía, reclama respeto.
programme.sub-title: El niño o la casa; Guantes rosados

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Iván es Drag Queen, contrata a Kevin para que le ayude a ser famosa, pero recibe una orden de deportación. Marta demanda a un prestamista, por las presiones de él, la hija de ella se suicidó.
programme.sub-title: Drag queen abusado; Gota a gota

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Alfredo descubre que varios hombres lo vigilan y su esposa está detrás de todo. El padre de Lisbeth se quita la vida después de que Carlos, un cazador de pedófilos, lo pilla y graba un video.
programme.sub-title: Perseguido por el pasado; Persiguiendo la verdad

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Andrés no soporta el cambio de su mujer a una vida más saludable y le pide el divorcio. Rubén descubre que su pareja, Pavel, le es infiel y busca compensación por los daños que le ha causado.
programme.sub-title: La gorda fitness; No se hagan los suecos

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Alejandro cree que maltrataron a su cuñado en el restaurante de Claudia, donde el chico trabaja, y la demanda. Sonia quiere que Juan José le devuelva su anillo, pero la prenda fue subastada.
programme.sub-title: Discriminación a la vista; Solo cenizas

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Lilian culpa al esposo de Claudia de profanar el cadáver de su marido para falsificar su identidad, pide compensación. Roxana está embarazada y su novio cree que un hijo contamina el planeta.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Por celos, el hijo de la pareja de Claudia mete al nuevo bebé de la familia en el horno. Ricardo y Alejandro están casados, pero difieren sobre la yegua Jénica y se pelean su custodia.

programme.desc: The Teletubbies watch some children making Christmas cards. Laa-Laa's present is some lovely decorations. When Noo-Noo tidies them up they tickle his throat, so he throws them out to decorate Home Hill.

programme.desc: Two children are making Christmas crackers for each other. Dipsy is very pleased to find his present is a cracker. He looks for someone to pull the cracker. It makes a lovely pink bang and the Teletubbies laugh when they fall over.

programme.desc: A group of children sing some Christmas carols to the Teletubbies. Tinky Winky opens his present to find a beautiful star inside. The Teletubbies follow it all over Teletubbyland, but where will is end up?
